Executable control used a fresh isolated store at /private/tmp/mote-body-stdin-chief.86r7yF. Input through `mote discuss post --body -` was exactly two lines plus final newline: line one; then literal shell metacharacters `$()` and backticks, angle brackets, and Unicode café. The stored JSON body was byte-for-byte `line one\nliteral $(not-run) `ticks` <angle> Unicode café\n`; it was not a literal hyphen. Command exited 0 and the post was visible. No storymodel source was changed. No live reservation exists on this bead or its coordination surface. Acceptance is satisfied; closing the stale external-DX bead.
